item.title: [Serverless Containers] - [fr-par] - issues connecting to resources inside Private Network [resolved]
item.description:
After investigation, we have found the root cause.
The issue happened because of blackholed traffic, but only on some Private Networks with a specific configuration:
- PNs with ACLs - PNs inside VPCs with "enable_routing" set to false
Anyway, we have rolled back the component causing the issues, so this error shouldn't happen anymore.
Sorry again for any inconvenience.
